issues.description: Visibility mismatch for two attribute getter methods: the exercise and UML/tests expect public getters for all Lecture attributes (problem statement asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute"), but in the solution implementation the methods getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private. This contradicts the expected public API and will confuse students (and any tests/examples) about the intended visibility of these getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public in the solution and any example/reference code so they match the problem statement and UML. Specifically, change the declarations in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java: change 'private String getLectureName()' (line 22) to 'public String getLectureName()' and 'private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()' (line 30) to 'public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()'. Ensure the visibility of all other attribute getters is consistently public.
